The R&D and design stage on the left side of the curve is marked with “R&D of textile machinery and high-grade fabrics,” “clothing fabric design,” and so on; the middle production and processing stage has “textile machinery manufacturing,” “thin fabrics,” “thick fabrics,” and so on; the market marketing stage on the right is marked with “market development of brands,” and “Shaoxing” is correspondingly marked in this marketing area. According to the label in the “market marketing” area on the right side of the figure, this stage corresponds to Shaoxing; the activity above this area is “market development of brands,” and it is located at a relatively high position on the value chain curve, indicating that the value quantity is relatively high. Therefore the answer is Shaoxing, and its main manifestation is engaging in market development of brands with high value quantity.
